note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997); the original is in English, and the soldier and worker descriptions are quoted from Kemner (1926) because no specimens of this species were examined; alates unknown; distribution records, synonymic citations, type information and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier body length 5.96–6.00 mm; head relatively short and broad, dorsoventrally flattened; head length with mandibles 3.80–4.00 mm, without mandibles 1.98–2.05 mm, width 1.16–1.23 mm; antenna length 2.30 mm; hind tibia length 1 mm. Labrum obliquely twisted, anterior margin with a rather deep median notch and long lateral angles; left mandible almost as long as the head, apex bluntly truncate. Worker body length 4.30–4.50 mm; head broadly oval and flattened; fontanelle very conspicuous.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head relatively short and broad, dorsoventrally flattened; fontanelle small, punctiform. Labrum of the usual obliquely twisted form, anterior margin with a rather deep median notch and long lateral angles. Left mandible almost as long as the head, apex bluntly truncate, neither pointed as in ceylonicus nor curved inward into a beak as in incola. Antennae 2.30 mm long, 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal in length. Hind tibia 1 mm long. Body length 5.96–6.00 mm; head length with mandibles 3.80–4.00 mm, without mandibles 1.98–2.05 mm; head width 1.16–1.23 mm; pronotum width 0.70–0.77 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head broadly oval, flattened; fontanelle very conspicuous, forming an oval pit with a flat bottom. Clypeus with a large and rather convex base. Antennae 14-segmented; segments 3 and 4 subequal, slightly shorter than segment 2. Anterior margin of pronotum without a notch. Body length 4.30–4.50 mm; head width 0.99 mm; pronotum width 0.53 mm.
